description: [Legacy Cloud Outbound Mailer API — merged into SENS on 2026-09-17; available only to projects migrated from Cloud Outbound Mailer and only for ~12 months (SENS overview: until Dec 2027). New mail sending/lookup: ncloud_sens_send_mail / ncloud_sens_list_mail_requests.] Replace a mail template (PUT /template/{templateSid}). This is a full replacement — templateName, title, body and senderAddress must all be sent again; the category cannot be changed here.

region.description: Region path segment (KR=/api/v1, SGN=/api/v1-sgn, JPN=/api/v1-jpn). Defaults to the server region (NCLOUD_REGION) when it is one of these, otherwise KR

senderAddress.description: Sender address (naver.com / navercorp.com / ncloud.com domains are not allowed)

templateName.description: Template name (1-100 chars of Korean, letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-')

name: ncloud_mailer_update_template
